scope: Technical intake and isolated gallery replay adapter only. No gallery catalog/index, game integration, visual redesign, or quality acceptance.

technicalChanges.index.html: Loads an embed-only stylesheet and enables its layout from the embed query parameter.
technicalChanges.preview/main.mjs: Reads embed and verify query parameters; embed starts the existing gain event and enables its existing full-lifetime repeat control; verify locks runtime audio mute and blocks the audio unlock control.
technicalChanges.preview/embed.css: Fits the existing H64 dual-background WebGPU preview into a gallery iframe and hides source-page controls and surrounding copy.
technicalChanges.shaders/field-body.wgsl and shaders/mana: Renames the WGSL struct member meta to attributes at its declaration and two reads in the canonical body and generated shader because meta is reserved by the WebGPU compiler; preserves field type, position, values, and use.
technicalChanges.tests/shader-reserved-words.test.mjs: Guards against reintroducing the compiler-rejected WGSL identifier meta in either shader source.

sourceQualityState: GPU playback and listening not run in supplied r0.3 evidence; this adapter does not make a visual quality acceptance decision.
manifestPolicy: source-manifest.json preserves the received manifest; manifest.json and SHA256SUMS describe this adapted public copy.
